description: View dimension = 'how far is the hierarchy currently expanded' plus an optional scope lens. The authority states that its §2 diagrams are five observation faces (语义边界 / 生产执行 / 模块 Contract / Authoring→Runtime / Bass 实例) of ONE system — that idea is what this dimension exists to carry. scopeLens: 'clear' = restore neutral colors, a scope id = apply that lens, 'keep' = do not touch colors. expansion: 'collapse'/'expand' name collapsible nodes; presets use idempotent hide/show sets (never toggle) so they never fight manual expand/collapse state.
